headline: Palantine Berm Ignites With Fresh Assaults As Northern Attrition Mounts
war_summary: Fighting has surged violently in Palantine Berm over the past two hours, where three rapid base transitions and a sudden rush of fresh enlistments marked renewed combat around Leiri Hermanni and The Droll. Further north, Weathered Expanse maintains its blistering pace of destruction, adding two more base exchanges in the latest hours as Crow's Nest and Frostmarch remain under heavy assault amid accelerating casualty rates. By contrast, the neighboring front in Stlican Shelf has cooled noticeably, recording no structural swings in the last two hours as combat tempo ebbs. The war's bloodiest meat-grinders persist unabated in Mooring County and Nevish Line, where neither side has yielded ground in recent hours despite thousands falling in bitter, close-quarters slugfests. Callahan's Passage has likewise grown markedly hotter, devouring over eleven hundred soldiers in two hours without altering the map, while Linn of Mercy and the southern interior hexes remain thoroughly dormant. With southern garrisons scrambling to meet the sudden burst in the Berm, the battle lines brace for widening engagements across both hemispheres.
